reason: Assembled the candidate in a scratch copy (shipping, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW=1, SKY_HELI=0: all build). All opcodes are 65SC12 (DEC/INC zp, BEQ, BRA, JMP abs; no BBR/RMB/etc.). JMP next_c + 4 assembles to next_c's BIT dm_flip in every build (next_c = DEC ds_c (2) / BEQ done (2)); ren_draw_sprite.drawn is the RTS in every build, the new BEQ to it is -32, same page (&9B92->&9B74 shipping, &9BAC->&9B8E full, &9BAA->&9B8C kc). Recount: empty column not last: old LDA3 CLC2 ADC2 STA3 BCS2 JMP3 SEC2 BRA3 DEC5 BEQ2 = 27 to BIT, new DEC5 BEQ2 LDA3 CLC2 ADC2 STA3 BCS2 SEC2 JMP3 = 24 (-3); last column: old 28 + RTS, new DEC5 BEQ3 = 8 + RTS (-20); page-crossed col_ptr path the same shape. Flipped carry path: no wrap old LDA3 INC2 BPL3 STA3 = 11, new INC5 BPL3 = 8 (-3); wrap 12 both; A/flags dead, C stays 1 (INC zp leaves C), same value stored (INC to &80 sets N, &40 stored). At ~4.3 empty columns a pass with 27% last: ~8 cycles an execution, ~33 a pass, as claimed. Bytes: flipped path 9->8, empty block 16->24: 7 bytes larger (claim's -7). Everything after &9B8D in bank 4 moves +7: branch crossing changes found by script over the listing: BEQ no_part starts crossing (+1 taken), BEQ in_hazel, BEQ gathered, BNE gather stop crossing; moved tables indexed by small X/Y change crossing for some indices (straight_sprite_hi &A4E4->&A4EB: X &15-&1B; wa_rows_guess &A0F5->&A0FC: X 4-&0A; others negligible) - layout costs of single cycles, covered by the candidate's whole-pass measurement (34457->34425, 39690->39651) and the gate's speed check. col_ptr (&C7/&C8) left one step back on the last empty column: not restored by restore_game_zp, the logic never reads it first (zplive), the prebuild's only read of &C8 is in walks it discards; as a pointer high byte &C9 (b_ptr low, a multiple of 8) cannot reach I/O. No self-modified operand or code-as-data in the moved lines (mask_operand/pix_operand are labels, written through their labels).
